selector_notice: Selectors choose source branches; they do not certify full upstream compatibility.

clock.notes: 32-bit wrapping clocks, integer-ms frame periods and cancellable waits

input.notes: held state, ordered queued edges, configurable long-exit gesture

graphics.notes: Documented Arduboy2 subset, basic geometry, bitmap/sprites and 5x7 text

avr_readers.notes: unaligned LE numeric reads and native pointer reads are distinct

save.notes: 1024-byte EEPROM mirror, versioned envelope and explicit migrations

audio.notes: up to 32 frequency/duration notes; host availability and settings apply

multitu.notes: independent C++ objects, COMDAT resolution and relocatable section merge

sketch.notes: main then alphabetical ino/pde, simple free-function prototypes, diagnostics for complex declarations

gpio.notes: pinMode/digitalWrite/analogWrite have no device pin mapping

spi.notes: legacy transfer echo is a compatibility placeholder, not bus I/O

rgb.notes: per-game RGB LED ownership is not mapped

system_buttons.notes: AVR flashlight/system-button startup behavior is not mapped

audio_repeat.notes: TONES_REPEAT is rejected; no partial playback

audio_volume.notes: volumeMode is rejected; hardware duty is fixed

avr_score.notes: Explicit registered LegacyScoreWordV1 spans, channel0, rests and owned repeat; compatibility mode reduces two channels to mono

resources.notes: One read-only MARB v1 sidecar; 256-byte cache, bounded offsets, compiled identity/version/length/CRC32 and install SHA256.

fx.scope: Read-only FXPK1 data, readDataArray, normal/masked bitmap; no save or raw SPI

managed_stop.notes: Cooperative CLI stop; returns through normal Sketch cleanup

relocatable_resources.notes: Resolve immutable sidecar beside the executing MBA version

legacy_degradations.time: Without RUNTIME, delay may be ignored and legacy nextFrame always accepts
legacy_degradations.audio: Without RUNTIME, playing may return false and byte0 settings remain; with RUNTIME, two-channel old scores reduce to mono only in compatibility mode
legacy_degradations.spi_gpio_rgb: no-op or echo placeholders; no physical hardware behavior
legacy_degradations.text: legacy base write consumes without drawing; games may override it
legacy_degradations.data: Arduino byte is 8 bits; pinned old score words use explicit LegacyScoreWordV1; pointer-word overloads remain source-specific
